g.text: Search runtime: 1,000 commits / 500 burst / normal / synchronization
3 shots per operation · whiskers: observed min–max, not confidence intervals · each panel has its own scale
Query p95 is computed within each invocation; query sample counts and all raw shots are retained separately.
Acknowledgment: write-sync = durable, refresh-dependent; async = submitted only; read-sync = visible, may be uncommitted; sync = durable + visible.
